artifactOwnership: Artist files immutable after design-manifest; runtime/evidence/freeze use separate files. Do not append runtime status into or reserialize this contract.

gallery.scope: GPT Pro original + Sol E, runtime author separately preserved

resources.roomTextureFormat: rgba8unorm; raw sRGB bitmap; world shader manually linear decodes
resources.canvasFormat: preferred WebGPU unorm format; post manually sRGB encodes

uniform.alignment: each draw has dedicated buffer or 256-byte dynamic offset; never overwrite one same buffer before submitting all draws
uniform.factory: scene.uniformsAt; set draw and bounds per draw

worldShader.drawOrder: draw-plan.mjs drawPlan: bitmap -> lamp/floor -> chronological steam -> purge
worldShader.geometry: each draw exact bounds quad; no all-room fragment invocation for each E

alphaOwnership.lampAndFloor: alpha0 additive lighting; original room occlusion is registration/boundary mask, not opaque light
alphaOwnership.steam: premult scattered radiance + density alpha, brightRGB0 but same alpha occludes earlier bright inputs
alphaOwnership.water: premult scatter + additive specular, water alpha; bright only tray specular
alphaOwnership.body: no actor fixture in room trial; do not invent one
alphaOwnership.base: bitmap alpha1, bright RGB0/alpha1; world pass clears both MRT before base draw

postShader.draw: one full-screen triangle, final sRGBencode+source-local OBS. PSF loop only inside finite nearSupport
postShader.near: 25 taps grid -2..2, offset3*max(DPR,fitScale) native px, normalized Gaussian weight exp(-.38*r2), gain.18
postShader.cross: tray input at transformed(920,343), sourceBright sample only, finite rotated8x3 originalpx, angle−12degrees, gain.12

time.owner: monotonic wall ms for finite display episode
time.loop: new episode with cleared voices/dedupe per loop; no accumulating old states
time.hidden: pause/reset presentation; stop all owned audio voices
time.stop: active false cancels all new effects immediately, keeps bitmap
time.reducedMotion: same sources/times/receiver and brightness; remove tiny lateral curl/drift/jet jitter via viewport.w
time.timingTruth: demo environmental states, not authoritative game operations

controls.diagnostics: same age params in ON/OFF captures; labels separate from adoption/quality

sfx.sync: CUES on same episode clock; independent cause per cue, cycle-specific dedupe
sfx.verify: URLSearchParams.has('verify') => no AudioContext creation, immutable gain0, __gallerySfx gesture cannot unmute
sfx.galleryHook: __gallerySfx.activateFromGesture(item), stop/dispose, restart loop same phase after gesture; no generic beep substitution
sfx.autoplay: VFX starts automatically; audio unlock only actual gesture outside verify
sfx.cleanup: stop voices, disconnect, close owned AudioContext on dispose
